articles.summary: Before you spend more on ads, fix the process handling the leads you already have. A founder who has rebuilt sales processes for 300+ businesses shares seven fixes, from mapping your process before touching the CRM to pre-call texts, right-sized lead lists, tandem dialing, and automated follow-up.
articles.title: 7 Sales Process Fixes to Make (Before Investing More in Lead Generation)
